dataset.name: Bambu Timelapse Dataset
dataset.notes: Timelapses are skimmed (a few encoded frames per print) and are unsuitable for ~1fps per-environment training; full-length videos (Borillion, 135 recordings) are real-time continuous footage.
dataset.provenance: Community-contributed timelapse/video footage from Bambu Lab printers; split into train/timelapses and train/videos.
